# pve_ceph_osd (Resource)

Creates and destroys one Ceph OSD on a node (`POST/DELETE /nodes/{node}/ceph/osd`). All creation attributes force replacement because the pin defines no OSD update verb; the OSD id is assigned by Ceph during the create task.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

resource "pve_ceph_osd" "sdb" {
  node               = "pve1"
  device             = "/dev/sdb"
  crush_device_class = "hdd"
  encrypted          = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) Block device name backing the OSD (pin `dev`), e.g. `/dev/sdb`.
- `node` (String) Name of the PVE node the OSD is created on.

### Optional

- `cleanup_on_destroy` (Boolean) Also destroy the underlying logical volumes via `ceph-volume lvm zap --destroy`, remove the volume group's physical volume with `pvremove`, and wipe leftover journal/block.db/block.wal partitions on destroy (pin `cleanup`, default `false`). When `false` the LVs and partitions are left intact for inspection.
- `crush_device_class` (String) CRUSH device class to assign the OSD in the CRUSH map (pin `crush-device-class`), e.g. `ssd` or `hdd`.
- `db_device` (String) Block device name for `block.db` (pin `db_dev`). Mutually exclusive with `osds_per_device`.
- `db_device_size_gib` (Number) Size in GiB for `block.db` (pin `db_dev_size`). Must be at least 1; requires `db_device`.
- `encrypted` (Boolean) Enable LUKS/dm-crypt encryption of the OSD (pin `encrypted`, default `false`).
- `osds_per_device` (Number) OSD services per physical device; only useful for fast NVMe devices. Must be at least 1 and is mutually exclusive with `db_device` and `wal_device`.
- `wal_device` (String) Block device name for `block.wal` (pin `wal_dev`). Mutually exclusive with `osds_per_device`.
- `wal_device_size_gib` (Number) Size in GiB for `block.wal` (pin `wal_dev_size`). Must be at least 0.5; requires `wal_device`.

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) Name of the host containing the OSD (from the OSD metadata read).
- `osd_data` (String) Path to the OSD's data directory, e.g. `/var/lib/ceph/osd/pve1-ceph-0`.
- `osd_id` (Number) OSD id assigned by Ceph during the create task.
- `osd_objectstore` (String) The object store type used by the OSD (typically `bluestore`).
- `version` (String) Ceph version of the OSD service.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# Import an existing OSD by its node and id:
terraform import pve_ceph_osd.sdb pve1:osd.0
```
